trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last reward: earn the other 54 trophies, using one story run and then the listed cleanup. Because missions cannot be replayed and there is no New Game+, retain a manual save at every chapter start plus an untouched save before the final mission; keep cheats off because they disable trophies and saving. Roadmap stage 7 — 100% and the platinum.
steps: Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter and before the final mission.
Complete the story once without cheats.
Use the game’s 100% checklist to close remaining requirements.
Review the tracker until all 54 other trophies are earned.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the Chapter 1 story mission named in this trophy. Complete that mission and the trophy pops automatically; make a manual save at the chapter start, since missions cannot be replayed later. Roadmap stage 1 — Chapter 1 and the one missable.
steps: Save manually at the start of Chapter 1.
Play Gone Fishing through its completion.
Confirm the automatic trophy pop, then keep cheats off.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Paradise Lost marks completion of Chapter 1, so it arrives automatically when you finish that chapter. Before advancing, do the balcony meditation lesson and keep a Chapter 1 save: the lesson is the safe route for the one confirmed missable. Roadmap stage 1 — Chapter 1 and the one missable.
steps: Keep a manual save at the Chapter 1 start.
Complete the Chapter 1 story after doing the balcony meditation lesson.
Leave cheats off and confirm the chapter trophy pops.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: This trophy pops automatically when Chapter 2 is complete. Save at the chapter start because there is no mission replay or New Game+; take the chapter transition as a cue to check any stranger chain already opened. Roadmap stage 2 — Chapters 2–4 and the story spine.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 2.
Play the Chapter 2 story to completion.
Before pressing deeper, check for stranger chains that have opened.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 for the automatic Vice City, Baby! pop. Keep the manual save made at the chapter start, and use pauses between story pushes to start any newly available stranger chain while its story window is open. Roadmap stage 2 — Chapters 2–4 and the story spine.
steps: Save manually at the start of Chapter 3.
Complete the Chapter 3 story missions.
Start any available stranger chain before advancing the story further.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Top Of The World, Ma is awarded automatically for completing Chapter 4. Preserve the start-of-chapter save, and clear stranger strands that are already underway before moving on because their windows are tied to story progress. Roadmap stage 2 — Chapters 2–4 and the story spine.
steps: Keep a manual save at the Chapter 4 start.
Finish Chapter 4 to trigger the automatic award.
Complete active stranger chains before pushing further into the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The final mission completion awards this story trophy automatically. Before starting it, make the required untouched manual save and finish any stranger chains you still intend to do; there is no mission replay or New Game+ if you want to revisit this point. Roadmap stage 7 — 100% and the platinum.
steps: Keep an untouched manual save before the final mission.
Finish any open stranger chains before launching it.
Complete the final mission with cheats off.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is the named story mission for this hidden trophy; finishing the mission awards it automatically. Keep the manual save from the start of its chapter, since the game has no mission replay, and leave cheats disabled on the trophy run. Roadmap stage 2 — Chapters 2–4 and the story spine.
steps: Save at the start of the chapter containing Breakfast Run.
Play Breakfast Run through completion.
Keep cheats off and confirm the automatic award.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist to receive Break the Bank automatically. A chapter-start manual save is your recovery point because missions cannot be replayed; keep the trophy run free of cheats. Roadmap stage 2 — Chapters 2–4 and the story spine.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of the current chapter.
Complete The Cartel Heist.
Confirm the trophy appears before advancing.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is the mission trigger: finish it and Family Matters pops automatically. Preserve the chapter-start save, as there is no replay or New Game+, and keep cheats disabled so the trophy remains available. Roadmap stage 2 — Chapters 2–4 and the story spine.
steps: Save manually at the chapter start.
Complete Child's Play in the story.
Leave cheats off and check for the trophy pop.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: The hidden DWNFALL trophy is tied to completing Headliners. Finish that named story mission for the automatic award, and keep the chapter-start manual save before moving on because missions cannot be replayed. Roadmap stage 2 — Chapters 2–4 and the story spine.
steps: Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.
Play Headliners through its completion.
Confirm the award and continue with cheats disabled.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is the story milestone that grants Hi-Jacked. Complete the mission for the automatic pop; save at the chapter start first, since there is no mission replay or New Game+ if you need a fallback. Roadmap stage 2 — Chapters 2–4 and the story spine.
steps: Save at the start of the current chapter.
Complete VCIA Takedown.
Check that the trophy pops, with cheats still off.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory completes the story requirement for Snow Storm and awards it automatically. Keep the chapter-start manual save, and if this is late in your run, finish stranger chains with open windows before pushing the story onward. Roadmap stage 2 — Chapters 2–4 and the story spine.
steps: Make a manual save at the chapter start.
Finish Operation Savage Glory.
Before further story progress, finish available stranger chains.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The game’s own checklist defines 100% completion; use it as the source of truth instead of treating every trophy-list entry as a checklist item. Most work overlaps with these activity, exploration and collection passes, so finish those and then inspect the in-game checklist for its remaining gaps. Roadmap stage 7 — 100% and the platinum.
steps: Open the game’s 100% checklist.
Complete the remaining listed activity, exploration and collection goals.
Recheck the checklist and close each outstanding item.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Cunning Stunts asks for 250 completed stunts, so use the stunt opportunities encountered during the free-roam cleanup and keep a tally as you go. The tracker counter is a manual reminder, not a game sync; return to this activity pass after the story. Roadmap stage 4 — Activities and mastery.
steps: Complete stunts during the free-roam activity pass.
Add each completed stunt to the tracker counter.
Continue until the tally reaches 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Master of None rewards trying each of the nine activity types once. Sample each distinct type during the activities pass rather than repeating a favorite; the counter here is a personal tally of types tried. Roadmap stage 4 — Activities and mastery.
steps: Choose an activity type you have not tried yet.
Take part once, then mark that type in the counter.
Repeat until all 9 types have been tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The Shootist requires gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the range challenge list and replay only a challenge that still needs gold; use the counter as your own checklist because it does not sync with the game. Roadmap stage 4 — Activities and mastery.
steps: Open the Shooting Range challenge list.
Earn gold in a challenge before moving to the next one.
Replay only challenges still short of gold.
Track all 42 gold medals in the counter.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun is about winning a Drone Race at every one of its 14 locations. Clear the locations systematically during the activities pass, marking each win so you do not revisit races already completed; this tracker counter is manual. Roadmap stage 4 — Activities and mastery.
steps: Visit a Top Fun Drone Race location.
Win the race and record that location.
Repeat at the remaining locations until all 14 are counted.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Earn Cash, Not Kudos counts wins in 20 different races, so favor a new race each time rather than farming the same event. Keep the tracker tally of distinct wins during the activities pass; it is a personal checklist, not a synced counter. Roadmap stage 4 — Activities and mastery.
steps: Select a race you have not won yet.
Win it and record that distinct race.
Repeat until the tally reaches 20 different races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Baited My Tackle names a direct target: beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take on Cal during the activities pass and make sure the result is a win; there is no extra count listed for this trophy. Roadmap stage 4 — Activities and mastery.
steps: Find and enter Cal’s fishing challenge.
Compete in the challenge and beat Cal.
Confirm the trophy after the result registers.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Stick Fiddler needs one completed arcade game, so choose an arcade cabinet during the activities pass and finish a full game. The description does not call for a score threshold or multiple games. Roadmap stage 4 — Activities and mastery.
steps: Choose an arcade game during free roam.
Play through one complete game.
Confirm completion before leaving the activity.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy’s final mission completes this stranger strand and awards Road to Rehabilitation. These chains open with story progress and can have closing windows, so begin Andy’s strand as soon as it appears and finish it before deepening the story; it also counts toward the eight-strand trophy. Roadmap stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start Andy’s strand when its marker first appears.
Complete its missions in order through the final mission.
Finish before advancing deep into later chapters.
trophies.missableNote: Stranger chains can have story-progress windows; start this chain as soon as it appears and finish it before pushing deep into later chapters.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton’s final stranger mission is the target for This Was No Boat Accident. Start the chain when it becomes available because stranger windows track story progress; finishing it also advances the shared total toward eight completed strands. Roadmap stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Begin Kenton’s chain as soon as it opens.
Follow the strand through its final mission.
Record it among the eight completed stranger strands.
trophies.missableNote: Stranger chains can have story-progress windows; start this chain as soon as it appears and finish it before pushing deep into later chapters.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: The Lone Rider is earned by completing Billy’s final mission. Start Billy’s chain at its first opening and finish it before pushing far into later chapters, since these stranger windows can be tied to story progress. Roadmap stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start Billy’s chain as soon as it appears.
Complete each strand mission through the finale.
Finish before making deep story progress.
trophies.missableNote: Stranger chains can have story-progress windows; start this chain as soon as it appears and finish it before pushing deep into later chapters.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: This silver award counts eight completed stranger mission strands across Leonida, including the named character chains. Since chains unlock over time and can have story-tied windows, begin each one as soon as it appears and record completed strands here. Roadmap stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start each stranger chain at its first opportunity.
Finish strands before advancing deep into later chapters.
Track completed strands until the count reaches eight.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Supply & Demand requires the final mission in Randy’s stranger chain. Pick up the chain as soon as it opens and complete it before major later-story progress, since stranger strands have story-linked windows; count it toward the eight-strand silver trophy too. Roadmap stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start Randy’s chain as soon as it appears.
Complete its missions through the final one.
Finish before pushing deep into later chapters.
trophies.missableNote: Stranger chains can have story-progress windows; start this chain as soon as it appears and finish it before pushing deep into later chapters.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Spin On This! comes from finishing Tyrone’s stranger strand. Start it as soon as its story window opens, complete the chain in order, and avoid leaving it until late chapters; this completed strand also contributes to the eight-strand goal. Roadmap stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Begin Tyrone’s chain when it first appears.
Complete each mission through its final mission.
Add the finished strand to your eight-strand tally.
trophies.missableNote: Stranger chains can have story-progress windows; start this chain as soon as it appears and finish it before pushing deep into later chapters.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: This is the only confirmed missable: do the balcony lesson with Lucia the morning after Down to Earth, in Chapter 1, and finish all 18 spot meditations before leaving that chapter. The lesson adds one to the count but is not marked as a spot; its necessity is unconfirmed, so accept it as the safe route, then have Jason and Lucia meditate at each spot because each character counts separately. Roadmap stage 1 — Chapter 1 and the one missable.
steps: In Chapter 1, follow Lucia to the balcony the morning after Down to Earth.
Accept the lesson and let Lucia teach you; keep this safe +1 even though it is not a marked spot.
Before Chapter 1 ends, visit all 10 meditation locations.
Meditate with Jason and Lucia at every spot to reach 18 sessions.
trophies.missableNote: Meditate at every spot before Chapter 1 ends; after that, the balcony session is gone for good.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Fair Game asks you to hunt a unique animal for Bret, so first open Bret’s stranger strand and follow its specific hunt objective. Stranger chains can have story-tied windows: start his chain as soon as it appears and finish it before deep later-story progress. Roadmap stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start Bret’s chain as soon as it becomes available.
Follow the strand until its unique-animal hunt objective appears.
Hunt the target for Bret and finish the chain promptly.
trophies.missableNote: Stranger chains can have story-progress windows; start this chain as soon as it appears and finish it before pushing deep into later chapters.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: The target is three complete collectible card sets, not three individual cards. Sweep one area at a time during the collectibles pass and use the game’s map or checklist to spot gaps; record each finished set in the manual counter. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Collect cards while sweeping one area at a time.
Use the map or checklist to find gaps in a set.
Mark each completed set until all 3 are done.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations is a broad map sweep, so work region by region and record each location after using WAiNK there. The counter here is a personal checklist rather than a game connection; revisit regions with gaps during the cleanup pass. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Sweep one region of Leonida at a time.
Use WAiNK at each location and mark it in the tracker.
Revisit gaps until the tally reaches 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: One Last Thing asks for 50 completed challenges. Treat the challenge list as a checklist, work through distinct entries, and use this manual counter to remember progress during the activities pass. Roadmap stage 4 — Activities and mastery.
steps: Open the challenge list during the activities pass.
Complete a challenge and record it.
Continue through the list until 50 are counted.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Hot Together has three conditions in one escape: reach a four-star Wanted Level, have your partner with you, then lose the level and escape the heat. Set up the partner situation before attracting the wanted level, then confirm the escape registers. Roadmap stage 5 — Crime, partners and free-roam feats.
steps: Have your partner with you before drawing police attention.
Reach a 4 star Wanted Level.
Lose the level and escape with your partner.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Retail Therapy requires three shop robberies back-to-back with your partner while never losing the Wanted Level. Plan an escape route first, then keep the wanted state active between robberies and tally each shop; the manual counter helps track the three-shop run. Roadmap stage 5 — Crime, partners and free-roam feats.
steps: Bring your partner and plan an escape route before the first shop.
Rob a shop and keep the Wanted Level active.
Reach the next shop without losing that level; repeat for 3 in a row.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Whip It Good counts 100 discovered vehicles, so make discovery part of your region-by-region free-roam sweep. Use the in-game map or checklist to revisit areas with missing entries, and mark the tracker as your personal tally. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Explore one region at a time and discover vehicles you encounter.
Check the in-game map or checklist for gaps.
Record discoveries until the tally reaches 100 vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Gunslinger is a single-use feat: five enemies must go down during one Combat Focus. Look for an encounter where five enemies can be handled together, activate Combat Focus for that sequence, and track the count as one complete attempt. Roadmap stage 5 — Crime, partners and free-roam feats.
steps: Wait for an encounter with at least five enemies.
Use Combat Focus for the encounter.
Take down five enemies during that single use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Catch Me If You Can names VCIA and an unscheduled departure as the trigger. At VCIA, look for the opportunity to depart without a scheduled booking and verify the game records the feat; the description does not specify a particular route. Roadmap stage 5 — Crime, partners and free-roam feats.
steps: Go to VCIA during free roam.
Make a departure that is not scheduled.
Check for the trophy pop after leaving.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke on purpose. Its plain reading points to something “hot” involving Rhinos, but that is only an interpretation of the wording, not a confirmed trigger or place; test the idea during free roam and verify in game. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Read the Rhino wording as a hint, not a confirmed instruction.
Try the plain reading during free roam without assuming a location.
Verify the result in game before marking it done.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Sneakthief specifies a jewelry store robbery completed without detection. Approach the robbery as a stealth goal, and do not treat an alarm or being spotted as progress; the description gives no named store, so use only a store the game identifies as a jewelry store. Roadmap stage 5 — Crime, partners and free-roam feats.
steps: Choose a jewelry store identified by the game.
Rob it without being detected.
Confirm the trophy before leaving the area.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Maximum Withdrawal requires five bank vault robberies and an escape after each. Work through the vault targets during the crime pass, plan each exit before entering, and count successful escapes rather than vault attempts. Roadmap stage 5 — Crime, partners and free-roam feats.
steps: Plan an escape before each bank vault robbery.
Rob the vault and escape successfully.
Repeat until five vault escapes are recorded.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: A Classic Blitz Play names one target: an Armored Truck. Find an opportunity during the crime pass, rob the truck and complete the escape; count only a run where the escape succeeds. Roadmap stage 5 — Crime, partners and free-roam feats.
steps: Locate an Armored Truck during free roam.
Rob the truck.
Escape successfully and confirm the trophy.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: The Goodtime State asks you to explore all Leonida, with 52 areas counted for this tracker. Reveal the map in regional sweeps and use the in-game checklist to identify uncovered areas; treat the counter as a personal tally, not a synced map. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Explore Leonida region by region.
Use the in-game checklist to find uncovered areas.
Record each area until all 52 are accounted for.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Pest Control requires an Illegal Operation robbery for each of nine gangs. Identify the gang tied to each operation and record a gang only after its operation is robbed; the counter helps prevent repeating the same group. Roadmap stage 5 — Crime, partners and free-roam feats.
steps: Find an Illegal Operation associated with a gang.
Rob the operation and record that gang.
Repeat for all 9 gangs, checking off each distinct group.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The description is a joke on purpose. Its plain reading is: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Treat that reading as a hint, not a confirmed trigger or location; try the described kind of action during free roam and record the result in game. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Read the description as a deliberate joke.
Use its plain reading as a tentative action idea, not a confirmed location.
Try the action during free roam and check the trophy notification.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description is a joke on purpose. Its plain reading is a dramatic vehicle-showroom escape after smashing your way out; that wording does not confirm a specific showroom or exact trigger, so treat it only as a clue to test in free roam. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Treat the showroom wording as a plain-reading clue.
Try the described kind of escape without assuming an exact location.
Confirm the trophy in game before counting it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The description is a joke on purpose, but it names Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley. Its plain reading is to follow through at that alley; no specific extra action beyond that wording is confirmed, so use it as a lead and verify the result in game. Roadmap stage 4 — Activities and mastery.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley named in the description.
Try the plain reading of “follow-through” there.
Verify the trophy rather than assuming an unconfirmed action.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is a joke on purpose. “A partnership with mass appeal” is its plain reading, but the words do not confirm a location, partner, or trigger; use that as an exploratory hint only and check the in-game award. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Treat “partnership with mass appeal” as a plain-reading hint.
Explore possible partner-related actions without assuming a specific trigger.
Confirm the result in game before marking it complete.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Actions Speak Louder tracks 500 choices, and PlayStation tracks the count to that total. Make choices as you play rather than pausing the story to farm them, then use the trophy counter to see when the threshold is reached; this tracker is a reminder. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Continue making choices during the story and free roam.
Check the PlayStation tracked count as it approaches 500.
Use the tracker counter as a reminder, not a game sync.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description is a joke on purpose. Its plain reading says “Second time’s the charm,” which suggests repetition but does not confirm what should be repeated or where; treat it as a clue, try possibilities in free roam, and verify the result. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Read “Second time’s the charm” as a clue, not a confirmed method.
Try a repeated action during free roam without assuming which one.
Check the in-game award before recording completion.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description is a joke on purpose. “What the hell just happened?” is only its plain reading, not a confirmed event or location; use it as a broad hint for an unusual free-roam moment and verify the trophy in game. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Treat the wording as an intentionally cryptic clue.
Explore unusual moments in free roam without assuming a trigger.
Verify the trophy pop before marking it done.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ten Pin describes a melee drive-by with a bowling pun: knock someone over using a melee attack from a vehicle. Try it during the free-roam feats pass and confirm the game registers the action; the description gives no further location requirement. Roadmap stage 5 — Crime, partners and free-roam feats.
steps: Drive near a suitable target during free roam.
Use a melee attack from the vehicle to bowl them over.
Confirm the trophy registers.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Dime on the Dollar tracks $250,000 earned by laundering Marked Bills through contacts. Use the contacts named by the game, record the money laundered rather than merely collected, and check the manual tally as you work through the cash cleanup. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Use contacts to launder Marked Bills.
Record the amount laundered through the contacts.
Continue until the total reaches $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Treat Yo Self is cumulative spending across all shops, with a $100,000 target. Spread purchases across the shops you visit during cleanup and use this tracker counter to keep a personal total; it is not synced to the game. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Visit shops during the cleanup pass.
Make purchases and add their spend to the manual tally.
Continue across shops until spending reaches $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Little Boxes requires buying all eight garage properties. Use the property opportunities as they appear during map cleanup, and keep the counter as a list of purchases so no garage is mistaken for a completed buy. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Review available garage properties during the map pass.
Purchase a garage property and record it.
Repeat until all 8 have been purchased.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: On the Spot counts ten vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app. Register each eligible vehicle through that app, then use the counter to track distinct registrations; do not count a vehicle until its registration is complete. Roadmap stage 6 — Collectibles, cash and the whole map.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register a vehicle and record the completed registration.
Repeat with distinct vehicles until the count reaches 10.
